verdict.rationale: Highnote's spend rules permit or restrict authorizations based on merchant category codes, and its docs say these rules can be set at the card, account, or program level and are evaluated at authorization before funds move. This covers MCC allow and block controls applied at authorization time. A single-merchant lock (by merchant ID) is not documented as a native spend rule; it would apparently require custom logic via collaborative authorization. Missing for 10: an explicit native single-merchant lock, explicit allowlist vs. blocklist configuration detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
